title: Use of `msg.value` inside a loop
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  The `batchCommitToMint` function attempts to call the `commitToMint` function multiple times within a loop, each time using the same `msg.value` that was provided when `batchCommitToMint` was called. While the `commitToMint` function works correctly on its own, it fails when invoked within the loop because the same `msg.value` is used multiple times.
